With `Continuous.range_subset_closure_image_dense`, the whole lemma can be proved by `upperBounds_mono_set` + simp.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ (upperBounds_mono_set (Set.image_subset_range f S))
  have hcl : range f ⊆ closure (f '' S) := hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS
  simpa [upperBounds_closure] using
    (upperBounds_mono_set hcl : upperBounds (closure (f '' S) : Set α) ⊆ upperBounds (range f))

candidates.requested_change: Replace the body of `Dense.continuous_upperBounds` with a proof using existing lemmas `hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense` and `upperBounds_closure` (no manual closure/frequently argument).

Searched Mathlib for existing lemmas matching the new `Dense.continuous_sup`/`Dense.continuous_sup'` statements (and for the underlying `continuous_upperBounds` shape); found no pre-existing equivalents outside the PR’s additions in `Topology/Order/IsLUB.lean`, so I cannot ground a duplication claim.

candidates.claim: In `Dense.continuous_inf'`, the current proof (lines ~247-261) redoes the bounded-below split and closure argument; since `⨅` is `⨆` in `OrderDual`, the lemma is an immediate corollary of `Dense.continuous_sup'` applied to `OrderDual α`.

theorem Dense.continuous_inf' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s := by
  classical
  -- dualize `Dense.continuous_sup'`
  simpa [sInf_range] using (hS.continuous_sup' (α := OrderDual α) (γ := γ) (f := f) hf)

candidates.requested_change: Replace the proof of `Dense.continuous_inf'` with a one-liner using `hS.continuous_sup'` on `OrderDual α` and `simpa [sInf_range]`.
